en: Recover the same chat and keep each unsent draft on this device after reopening.
Keep an unstaged question separately when a different draft already exists, with an Unsent message card.
Recovery and reading failures now preserve their specific cause and next step in problem notes.
Improve invitation format guidance and avoid automatic input replacements; give screen readers a separate reply-complete state.
zh: 重新打开应用时恢复同一对话，并在本机保留各段对话的未发送草稿。
问题尚未发出、输入框又有另一段草稿时，两份内容分别保留，先前的问题显示为“未发送的内容”。
恢复或打开失败时，问题记录保留更具体的情况和下一步。
改进邀请码格式提示，关闭自动输入替换；为读屏单独提供回复完成状态。

en: Since build 45: fix a local recovery error involving unrelated messages and keep sign-in available after recoverable local failures.
Ordinary travel wording no longer hides an entire reply by itself. Earlier failed messages keep the results shown at that time.
zh: 与构建 45 相比：修复一种由无关消息影响对话恢复的本机错误；可恢复的本机故障不再直接丢失登录。
普通旅行用语不再单独导致整段回答消失；过去失败的消息仍保留当时结果。

en: Leave a draft in an existing chat, switch away and lock the phone, then check the same chat and draft return.
Force-quit and reopen; check the same conversation and exact draft return.
Start a chat and ask “Who are you?” and “What can you do?”, in either language.
If anything fails, copy View problem notes with the time; preserve the chat rather than repeatedly submitting the same question.
zh: 在已有对话里留一段草稿，切后台并锁屏后回来，检查同一对话和草稿。
强制关闭应用后重开，核对是否回到同一对话、文字是否完整保留。
新建对话，用中文或英文问“你是谁”“你能做什么”。
若有失败，复制“查看问题记录”并附大概时间；保留会话，不要连续重复提交同一句。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Trip planning is still being fixed. Please do not test it yet.
Formal planning saves, edits, undo and Remember preferences still need their own live checks.
Segmented replies and multiple-choice exploration remain designated tests, not the normal default. Physical-device checks remain to be completed.
zh: 规划功能仍在修复，暂不建议测试规划。
正式保存行程、修改、撤销和记住偏好仍需各自的真实验证。
分段、多选探索仍仅供指定测试，尚未向普通聊天默认开启；真机检查仍待完成。

en: The paired Hong Kong service source 064b3c99 changes trip discussions, preference understanding and failure tracking.
Service fixes apply automatically without reinstalling the App. Account qualification and allowances do not change when you install an update.
zh: 配套香港服务来源 064b3c99，改动涉及行程讨论、偏好理解和失败定位。
服务端修复自动生效，无需重新安装应用；安装更新不会改变账号资格和额度。

en: Chat-opening errors now distinguish offline, expired or disabled sign-in, service trouble, unreadable local records and unclear failures, with a next step.
View problem notes on the failure page: up to 20 on-device records with time, build, category, step and service reference. Copyable; no message text or sign-in details.
The same notes appear at the end of Internal demo information.
zh: 对话打不开时，提示会说明具体情况：网络不通、登录过期或停用、服务出错或维护、本机保存的记录打不开、具体情况还不清楚，并给出下一步。
失败页新增“查看问题记录”：只存在本机，最多 20 条，含时间、构建号、类别、环节和服务端参考号，不含消息内容或登录信息，可以复制。
内部演示说明末尾也能查看同一份问题记录。

en: Since build 44: situation-specific messages and on-device problem notes; how chats reopen and send is unchanged.
Trip planning and default chat access remain unchanged.
zh: 与构建 44 相比：新增按情况区分的提示和本机问题记录；对话恢复和发送方式没有改变。
规划功能没有因此修好，日常账号的默认对话方式没有改变。

en: Leave an unsent draft in an existing chat, switch away and lock the phone, then check the same chat and draft return.
Force-quit and reopen; check the same chat and draft return.
If opening fails, screenshot the page and View problem notes, or copy the notes; include the time.
From the menu, open Internal demo information and scroll to Problem notes.
zh: 打开一段已有对话，留一段未发送的文字，切后台并锁屏后返回，检查同一对话和草稿。
从多任务界面强制关闭应用后重新打开，检查能否回到同一对话和草稿。
如果对话打不开，请截图该页，再点“查看问题记录”截图或复制，并记下大概时间。
从菜单打开内部演示说明，翻到最后查看问题记录。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Trip planning is still being fixed. Please do not test it yet.
Planning, saving, edits, undo and preferences await live checks.
Why chats would not open on build 43 is still not identified; the new messages help show the next failure clearly.
Segmented replies, choices and profile tags are designated tests, not on by default.
zh: 规划功能仍在修复，暂不建议测试规划。
规划、保存、修改、撤销和记住偏好尚待本轮真实验证。
构建 43 上对话打不开的具体起因仍未查明；新提示用于看清下一次失败的情况。
新版分段、多选和画像交互目前仅供指定测试，未向日常账号默认开启。

en: Hong Kong service source 2e5560cf adds request metadata logs without message content.
The service reference in problem notes helps match failures to those logs.
These server changes have no visible effect and need no app update.
Planning and English city request fixes continue; planning retests remain on hold.
zh: 香港在线服务来源 2e5560cf 新增请求元数据记录，不记录消息内容。
问题记录里的服务端参考号可与这份记录对应，便于按时间查到失败的情况。
没有用户可感知的服务端变化；这些服务端更新不需要更新应用。
规划和英文城市请求的修复仍在进行，规划复试继续暂缓。
